uncertainties.issue: Source is an open 'ittai, nan nanda...?' right after 'he called me Barrel'. It can mean 'what on earth is he?' or 'what on earth is going on?'. The draft's 'What on earth is this...?' keeps it open and was left; if the orchestrator prefers a more natural line, 'What on earth is going on...?' is equally open. Not changed because it is not wrong.
'opening rate' for kaikouritsu (aperture ratio of the Wormhole) is a coined rendering; not found elsewhere in the corpus or encyclopedia. Left; flag if the Encyclopedia later fixes a term.
Speakers untagged. 2391 (ore, fought Berkt, senses a will) and 2394 (Satellite Cannon, so a Gundam X speaker) are not named in the English, so no identity is asserted.
Speaker speaks for the Nadesico with -san politeness; most likely its captain, but unnamed in the English. -san dropped per corpus practice; nothing depends on it.

'What was that thing back there?' - referent of 'sakki no are' is not stated (the answer in 2418 talks about Shin Dragon's evolution, so it is probably the transformation seen in the battle). English stays as vague as the source.

Rank: source says junshou + kakka. 'Brig. Gen. Cowen' keeps the source rank; canon 0083 gives Cowen a higher rank, and row 2471 (next slice) has the same junshou. Whatever is decided must be applied to both slices by the orchestrator; legacy material, not in the next build.
'still accelerating' for kasokudo wo mashite (gaining acceleration) - 'still' is a slight addition, harmless; left.
Chulip singular/plural is unmarked in the source; singular kept to match 1468/1485.
